conventions.convention: The reference triangle is T = {(x,y): 0 ≤ y ≤ x ≤ 1}; D(r,s) = (r,rs), with Jacobian determinant r and the edge r = 0 collapsed to the origin.
The principal value removes equal distances ε on both sides of the interior pole, with 0 < ε < min(c-a,b-c).
The Jacobi density is (1-t)^α(1+t)^β on (-1,1), extended by zero at both endpoints; its measure is on relative Borel subsets of [-1,1], and its construction assumes Countable Choice.
The finite transformed trapezoid uses h > 0 and nonnegative integer cutoffs N₋, N₊, including samples k = -N₋ through N₊. Its three modes are tanh–sinh, exp–sinh and sinh–sinh, respectively.
The strip estimate requires 0 < a < d and uniform exponential decay throughout the closed substrip |Im z| ≤ a; real-axis integrability alone is insufficient.
For the radial weight r^ρ, ρ = 1-α, the shifted Jacobi weights are 2^(-(ρ+1)) times the [-1,1] weights; the unweighted coordinate uses half its [-1,1] weights.

Endpoint regularization splits at c = (a+b)/2, uses positive integer powers q_a,q_b with q_a(α+1)-1 > 2n and q_b(β+1)-1 > 2n, assigns both transformed endpoint values zero, and uses the unweighted Jacobi rule.

load_bearing.statement: Assume Countable Choice. For n ≥ 1 and α,β > -1, the Gauss–Jacobi rule integrates every polynomial of degree at most 2n-1 exactly and has positive weights. For g ∈ C^(2n)([-1,1]), its error equals g^(2n)(ξ)/(2n)! times the squared integral of the monic node polynomial for some ξ ∈ (-1,1), and is bounded by K_(n,α,β) times the supremum norm of g^(2n).

Let α < 2 and q:T → R be continuous. For f(x,y) = ‖(x,y)‖₂^(-α)q(x,y) away from the origin, the improper triangle integral is absolutely convergent and equals the iterated integral of r^(1-α)G(r,s), where G(r,s) = (1+s²)^(-α/2)q(r,rs).

For two finite positive measures with valid n-node Gaussian exactness and remainder data, and G with continuous pure partial derivatives through order 2n on the compact rectangle, the tensor error is at most K_μ M_ν ‖∂_x^(2n)G‖∞ + M_μ K_ν ‖∂_y^(2n)G‖∞.

Assume Countable Choice. For α,β > -1, the endpoint-zero extension of (1-t)^α(1+t)^β defines a finite positive Borel measure on [-1,1], with full relative support and finite absolute moments of every nonnegative integer degree.

If F is holomorphic on |Im z| < d and satisfies |F(x+iy)| ≤ C exp(-η|x|) for |y| ≤ a, where 0 < a < d and h > 0, the infinite trapezoid sum converges absolutely and its error is at most (I₊+I₋)/(exp(2πa/h)-1), where I₊ and I₋ are the absolute horizontal-line integrals.

For continuous Φ with |Φ(t)| ≤ A exp(-B exp(κ|t|)) when |t| ≥ T, with A,B,κ > 0 and T ≥ 0, both continuous tails and omitted trapezoid samples beyond cutoffs N₋h,N₊h ≥ T are bounded by A/(κB) times the sum of exp(-B exp(κN₋h)) and exp(-B exp(κN₊h)).
For nonnegative integers r,m and γ > r, the function t^γ(log t)^m on (0,1], extended by zero at zero, belongs to C^r([0,1]) and has derivatives of orders zero through r equal to zero at zero.
For a < c < b and f ∈ C¹([a,b]), the symmetric principal value exists and equals the ordinary integral of the continuous divided difference g, plus f(c) log((b-c)/(c-a)), with g(c) = f′(c).

seams_checked.note: Checked the supplier statements against lem-bem-panel-pair-duffy-certificates, alg-bem-certified-inexact-matrix-assembly and thm-bem-matrix-perturbation-transfer. The standard panel construction supplies smooth reference-triangle amplitudes with α = 0, uses radial mass 1/2 and the correct pure-coordinate derivative constants, and charges nested evaluation errors separately. Custom identities explicitly require verification of all Gaussian hypotheses. The supplier page limits itself to a flat reference triangle and does not claim to supply the additional panel-pair decomposition. No reverse logical dependency is asserted.
